gradual_evolution.targets: fresh + nine fully signed mature closed cuboid parameter profiles

hero_power_path_067.scope: Ordinary living Hero adult with locked Power FIRST evolution. Full signed later axes include opposite Run training without changing first type or biological age.
hero_power_path_067.reference: Fresh independently operated Chao Island viewer with actual red Power checkbox selected, Hero alignment, age and both later axes. Fresh front/side and all nine mature front/side/back plus Run/Power/Fly/Swim above originals personally inspected before authoring. Imported official HeroPower cuboids supply construction context only.
hero_power_path_067.approximation: Three two-section closed cuboid lobes interpret compact fresh/balanced knobs, a large central Power bulb, long rear-swept Run points, broad Fly/Swim outer fins and long thin central rear blades. Mixed states have separately authored dimensions. Fixed original skull does not reproduce the source rear wedge. Smooth curves, taper, round bulbs, source wing/tail forks and repeated tiny coat spots are simplified. Linear maturity and bilinear current-axis blends approximate nonlinear source timing.
hero_power_path_067.head_caps_policy: White/inherited roots use body127. Four existing cap side faces wrap a two-dimensional4x4 patch tile116..119/60..63, V proximal-to-distal along negative localY, U across localX orZ. PositiveY terminal125; negativeY terminal126. No stripe meshes, forehead paint, hidden auxiliary forks or replacement head shell.
hero_power_path_067.wing_policy: Three opaque closed cuboid rays per unchanged wing joint; fixed directions -12/+18/+48 degrees retain exact proximal hinge [0,.25,0]. Four longitudinal faces carry root124/distal123 pigments, and differing thicknesses avoid parallel coplanar overlap.
hero_power_path_067.body_contact_policy: Top-only torso extension +.45 supports scoped walking head lift. Original joints and shoulder anchors remain exact; first-Power fists/shoes begin modestly bulky and develop compact broader dimensions.
hero_power_path_067.tail_policy: Original small tail geometry, native UVs and attachment retained unchanged.
hero_power_path_067.marker_policy: Square four-bar Hero halo uses original emotion_dots/emotion_dot anchors and tilt; first bar retains original atlas artwork, three mesh-only children add the remaining bars.
hero_power_path_067.provisional_rates: 960 current level-bar progress per opposing axis; independent adult maturity. Viewer settings do not establish original game levels or timing.
